criteria.test_procedure: Play one Earth and one Black Vegas game on both devices with fictional funded Campaign wager, isolated Free Play wallet reset and authoritative multiplayer/reconnect; deny real-world-value stakes.
criteria.required_observation: Record actual user-visible state and matching authoritative owner event/deny/recovery evidence; empty, synthetic-only, or source-only receipt is not a pass.

evidence_capture_instructions.device_roles: Windows GM and Android Player plus reverse-direction and Android GM/Creator whenever current source acceptance requires. Two distinct human testers/verified subjects, not two local mocks.
evidence_capture_instructions.minimum_receipt: Record immutable app head, artifact/platform version, human/role/device binding, time, Campaign and Session pseudonymous correlation, source-owner event IDs, actual vs expected, sanitized screenshot/recording, log digest and negative-case outcome.
evidence_capture_instructions.privacy: No secrets, payment tokens, protected clue text, owner-only content or raw personal data in GitHub test receipts. Hash/redact private tokens and segregate GM-only evidence.
evidence_capture_instructions.assumption_prohibition: Source PR/contract, synthetic fixtures, queued workflows, in-process mock actors, or archived screenshots alone are NOT installed two-human PCV acceptance.
evidence_capture_instructions.sequential_owner_gate: PCV-03F must close before PCV-04; PCV-04 through PCV-10 remain blocked_by_predecessor and must be selected by their own OPS5 GPR owner.
